title: Copy-loop sites
statement: The copy-loop site set has six kinds of labels: two node-processing sites, two return sites carrying a Boolean child value, and two literal-processing sites carrying a Boolean polarity. The first node site copies the depth into the input pointer; the second does the same for the second copy, for which the pointer is $2K$. The return sites make the corresponding first and second copies, and the literal sites copy the depth into the counter or the stack into the scratch register.
